# KCK — Kalacakra Calendar software (Edward Henning)
Downloaded 2026-08-07 from kalacakra.org/calendar/kck1101.zip (v1.03).
MIT license (stated in every source file, © 2009-2011 Edward Henning).
Banked as the reference implementation for a future full Phugpa/karana
day-level port (with Janson's "Tibetan Calendar Mathematics" as the
mathematical spec). The shipped year-level colophon helper
(core/src/tibcal.cpp) is independent 60-cycle arithmetic pinned by
documented anchor years — this code is not yet compiled into allcore.
